data.name: Rajmonda
data.gender_notes: Rajmonda is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin 'Ragimundus', meaning 'advice-protector' or 'recommender of strength'. In Christianity, Rajmonda is associated with Saint Raymond of Penyafort, a lawyer and advisor to popes, and a protector of pilgrims and students. The name Rajmonda carries the meaning “Advisor, protector, and powerful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Rajmonda usually hope their child will grow to embody advisor, protector, and powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
